question: Related Questions Q. Scholarship 3083 views Q. Assalamu alaikum w w Respected brothers we have a small flour mill at village . My father has been running it for the past 4 years but now a problem has raised . villagers bring their corns (the seeds of) plants, such as wheat , maize and we grind them . answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 31783 Country: India Title: instalmment transaction Question: A company sells a car for 1000000/- rs if i pay net amount at the time of purchase but on installment it costs 1200000/- (100000/- per month) for total 12 months. is it permissible or it comes under interest. please reply Answer ID: 31783 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 817/817/M=1432) It is lawful to sell in less price in case of cash payment and increase the price in late payment. It is alright to deal in a car of 10 lakhs for 12 lakhs on instalments, but the matter of cash payment or late payment should be very clearly defined. هكذا في كتب الفتاوي. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
